name: Vermin Repellent Agent (Major)

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Pathfinder Society Guide

text:
Activate 3 Interact

---
This specialized cream serves as a repellent to stave off insects.

The repellent also binds with a number of common insect venoms, dulling the potency and giving the wearer's immune system a boost to resist venoms.

Once applied to your skin, the repellent grants you a +4 item bonus to Fortitude saving throws against poisons for 4 hours.

Effect: Vermin Repellent Agent

---
In addition, any arthropods (insects, spiders, scorpions, crabs, and similar invertebrate animals) must attempt a DC 35 Will save save when attempting to attack you with a melee Strike, or with a swarm attack such as the spider swarm's swarming bites. The arthropod then becomes temporarily immune for 1 minute.

---
Critical Success The creature can act normally.

Success The creature is Frightened 1.

Failure The creature is Frightened 2.

Critical Failure The creature is frightened 2 and Fleeing.
